data.one_liner: Presents your app and its features using customizable guides and focused highlights.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to create step-by-step tutorials highlighting specific widgets on the screen with custom shapes, overlays, and descriptions. It supports skipping, moving forward and backward programmatically, and custom target content positioning.
use_when: You need to guide new users through your app's interface and key features.
You want to highlight specific widgets with customized shapes and tooltips/content overlays.
avoid_when: You are building a standard multi-page onboarding walkthrough that doesn't need to highlight specific widget coordinates on the screen.
You want a fully declarative state-driven coach mark solution.
strengths: Supports multiple content positions relative to focused targets.
Allows custom shapes (circle, rounded rectangle) and blur effects on shadows.
Provides helper methods to control the tutorial flow programmatically (next, previous, goTo, skip, finish).
weaknesses: Relies on GlobalKeys or manual target positions to anchor the highlight.
Imperative setup can become verbose when managing complex onboarding sequences.
